groups.title: Binary Semaev splitting: literature result and matched-audit work
groups.exact_statement: For k=F_(2^n), nonsingular y^2+xy=x^3+a*x^2+b, and ell-dimensional F2-subspace V, compare S4(x1,x2,x3,r)=0 on V^3 with S3(x1,x2,u)=S3(u,x3,r)=0 for u in k. If A(T)=S3(x1,x2,T) and B(T)=S3(T,x3,r) both have degree two and deg gcd(A,B)<=1, Res(A,B)=0 iff there is a unique common root u in k.
essential_hypotheses: Binary extension field and Boolean coordinate descent.
Leading coefficient conditions x1!=x2 and x3!=r.
The gcd-degree hypothesis excludes quadratic gcds; exceptional degree drops, roots only in extensions, infinity, point recovery and sum verification remain separate.

groups.title: ECC2K-130 Weil factor: bounded Jacobian necessary-condition checks
groups.exact_statement: For E/F2: y^2+xy=x^3+1 and W=Res_(F_(2^131)/F2)E ~ E x A with dim A=130, define virtual curve counts C_k=2^k+1-p_k from the roots of P_A and closed-place counts a_d=(1/d) sum_(e|d) mu(d/e) C_e. If A is F2-isogenous to a genus130 Jacobian, these must be nonnegative integers.

evidence.kind: Exact-integer computation reported by author; source and retained correction log inspected; no new independent replay
evidence.cross_check: Newton power sums versus the structural formula p_k=-s_k^E if 131 does not divide k, and 130*s_k^E otherwise.
